audit_title: June–July 2025 rare-earth licensing: transaction scope, administrative process and company choices
status: Bounded developmental research for parent review; no chapter edits
temporal_scope: Rules effective before and during April–July 2025. August 6 company call used explicitly for retrospective June–July performance and then-current response options. No October 2025 or 2026 law silently substituted.
counting_rule: Nine originating documents. Reposts and indexed renderings grouped with their original. Two JL Mag records and two Bajaj records are repeated issuers, not four independent witnesses. Reused EC25 records do not add to this count.

sources.author_or_issuing_body: MOFCOM Industrial Security and Import and Export Control Bureau
sources.publication_date: 2025-03-28 (page date; current wording differs from April reproductions)
sources.source_type: primary procedural guidance, version-checked using dated reproductions
sources.reading_scope: Full current substantive HTML text read in browser: 31 application fields, self-check instructions/table, all 66 FAQs. PDF attachment located (35 pages) but download failed; no PDF reading claimed. April 2 Sichuan repost read through application fields, self-check and FAQs 1–39; FAQ 44 and related material read in indexed rendering. Xinping April 15 indexed excerpts read, including complete FAQ 33; direct page timed out.
sources.decisive_locator: Current guide application fields 20/22/31; self-check 规范性5/7 and 一致性; FAQs 1,6,19–25,29,31,33–39. April 2 reproduction browser lines 195–200,250–318 verify timing/contract/end-use/duration. FAQ 44 differs across current ministry and April copies.
sources.supports: Contract-specific application; consistent end-user/use documentation; clock from acceptance and from complete materials after return; usual six-month single-license validity predates London; phased shipment certificates do not expand total quantity.
sources.limits: Guidance rather than individual decision. Original page's March date cannot date every sentence: FAQ 44 now says classification-advice letters have no validity period, whereas April reproductions say six months. This is distinct from FAQ 33 on license duration. Core details used are matched against April 2. Photographs are permissive in the guide, not a universal mandatory requirement. General-license availability in law does not prove June issuance.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: All versions reproduce the same originating guidance and are one source chain. Dated copies corroborate historical wording, not independent policy decisions. Sichuan page identifies itself as the provincial trade-promotion council's enterprise-service platform; its exact administrative affiliation is not used to infer MOFCOM authority.

sources.author_or_issuing_body: State Council; MOFCOM licensing bureau republication
sources.reading_scope: Read promulgation and Articles 1–41 in browser, including complete licensing and end-user sections. Capture includes further articles; no complete-regulation reading claimed.

sources.independence_and_source_chain: Official republication of the same State Council instrument, not a new ministry rule or corroborating witness.

sources.author_or_issuing_body: Bajaj Auto; executive director Rakesh Sharma and CFO Dinesh Thapar
sources.source_type: primary company retrospective on June–July and contemporary account of response options
sources.reading_scope: Full 20-page PDF acquired and searched. Complete printed/physical pages 4,7,16,17 read; p. 5 first continuation paragraph read in browser; earlier browser opening identifies executives. Pages 4,7,17 visually checked. No whole-call reading claimed.
